## Summary

What changed, and why?

## Branch target

- [ ] Feature/fix PR targets `dev_v1.0`, or this is a release PR from `dev_v1.0` into `main`
- [ ] No direct development on `main`; auto-merge is disabled

## Related issue

Link the issue or explain the scope here.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci` and `npm run check` pass
- [ ] New or changed behavior has regression coverage
- [ ] UI changes include relevant interaction checks; visual checks are reported separately
- [ ] API keys, personal content, exported projects, logs, and local environment files are excluded
- [ ] README accurately describes capabilities and remaining limits

Commands run and results:

## Risks and limitations

Include storage/migration effects, provider data transmission or cost changes, and unverified behavior.

## Review

- [ ] Opened as a draft until implementation and validation are ready
- [ ] Ready for review only after local checks and CI pass

Do not merge until review is complete and required checks are green. These checkboxes document the process; they do not configure repository protection.
